conventions.timestamps: TEXT UTC ISO-8601 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.sssZ' (repo convention strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now')); period boundaries 'YYYY-MM-DD'; published_at may be date-only
conventions.numeric: REAL = IEEE-754 double; ±2^53 CHECK bound; verbatim text_value preserves fidelity; NULL numeric unless value_state=PRESENT

ids.native_component: release_key = edition label | source version stamp | content digest (source_native_release_id kept separately)
ids.canonicalization: 'rel_' + first 24 hex of sha256(dataset_id|release_kind|release_key); components NFC, '%'→%25, '|'→%7C, controls→%XX
ids.collision: PK + UNIQUE(dataset_id, release_kind, release_key); PK clash with a different triple is a hard failure

ids.canonicalization: 'art_' + sha256(bytes) hex; API captures 'req_' + hex sha256(request descriptor ‖ response digest)

ids.native_component: source_native_key stored separately (never part of the hash input except via dimset)
ids.canonicalization: 'ser_' + lowercase base32(first 20 bytes of sha256(canonical_series_key)); key = 'v1|dataset_id|indicator_native|geography_id|unit|sex|age|standardization|estimate_type|scenario|dimset_hash'; components percent-encoded as for release_id; dimset_hash = first 16 hex of sha256 of sorted 'KEY=VALUE' lines joined by \n over extension dimensions
ids.collision: PK + UNIQUE(canonical_series_key) in clear; CHECK key prefix = 'v1|'+dataset_id+'|'

ids.canonicalization: external text form '<series_id>~<period_key>~<release_id>'; period_key per granularity: Y2024, Q2024-2, M2024-03, W2026-37, D2026-03-01, R:<start>/<end>, X:<native>
'run_' + 26-char Crockford ULID issued by the Worker
ids.collision: PK; idempotency never depends on it

ids.canonicalization: dedupe_key = sha256(event_type|canonical_url_key|release_id); id = 'sev_' + first 24 hex of dedupe_key

idempotency.same_release_same_value: no-op (UPSERT WHERE fingerprint differs matches nothing)
idempotency.newer_release_changed_value: new immutable version, previous_release_id set, class SOURCE_REVISION|CORRECTION|METHODOLOGY_CHANGE|UNKNOWN_REVISION
idempotency.older_release_arriving_late: BACKFILL version, previous NULL; never displaces a newer current value
